messages:
alex: PR up — split helpers into smaller utils modules to prep for the serializer cleanup. Mostly file moves + small API tweaks, preserving top-level exports. looking for 1-2 reviewers for style/import ordering + surface check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234

maria: taking a look now, will check for import churn and backward compatibility. do you have a migration plan for internal callers?

alex: thanks! no migration required — kept same exports in index.ts so callers don't change. tests pass locally. ci shows one lint error i'm fixing.

ci-bot: CI: lint failed on utils/parse.ts:42 — prefer longer variable names for clarity. details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1234

kevin: @alex can you paste the exported surface diff? quick grep would do. if exports unchanged i'm fine with style moves.

alex: sure — snippet:
```
$ git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD
utils/io.ts
utils/parse.ts
utils/fmt.ts
index.ts

$ rg "export .* from" utils -n
utils/io.ts:1:export { load_text as load } from './io/load_text'
utils/parse.ts:1:export * from './parse/parse_impl'
index.ts:1:export * from './io'
index.ts:2:export * from './parse'
```

maria: LGTM overall. left tiny nits in PR comments about import order and one TODO that can be a follow-up. :thumbsup:

kevin: gave :eyes: and approved in the PR. if CI goes green after lint fix, feel free to merge + squash.

alex: rebased + fixed lint, re-ran CI, all green now. merging after a 10m hold in case anyone else spots something. i'll schedule a quick canary deploy for the downstream service tomorrow AM. thanks both!

maria: :+1:
